Can I use an SD card on Nintendo Switch?

No. Only microSD cards can be used on the Nintendo Switch console. Due to the slot size, SD cards and miniSD cards are not compatible with Nintendo Switch.

Can I use a microSD card on Nintendo Switch 2?

No. Only microSD Express cards can be used on the Nintendo Switch 2 console.

For more information on compatibility, please see microSD Card and microSD Express Card Compatibility.

Are microSD cards included with the Nintendo Switch system?

No, microSD cards are sold separately.

Which microSD cards are supported?

The following types of microSD cards are supported on Nintendo Switch:

microSD (up to 2 GB)
microSDHC (4 GB - 32 GB)
microSDXC (64 GB - 2 TB)

Important:In order to use a microSDXC card on the Nintendo Switch console, a system update is required.

In order to improve your gameplay experience, using a microSD card with a higher transfer speed is recommended.

Downloadable software
Software update data
Downloadable content (DLC)
Screenshots and captured videos

Important: Game save data is stored to the System Memory and cannot be copied or saved to a microSD card.

Can I move data from the system memory to a microSD card?

Screenshots and captured gameplay videos can be moved from the system memory to a microSD card, and vice versa. You can also transfer downloadable software if the system is updated to Version 10.0.0 or higher.

When a microSD card is inserted in the console, it becomes the default save location for downloadable software.

Game save data cannot be copied to a microSD card.

Can I use multiple microSD cards with my system?

We recommend using a single microSD card with your Nintendo Switch console. If you run out of space, you can copy over all the data to a larger microSD card.

Keep in mind that downloadable software saved to multiple microSD cards cannot be combined later into a single microSD card.

# Nintendo Switch OLED Starter Buying Guide & Retailer Comparison

This buying guide is based on live checks of official Nintendo technical specifications and support documentation, alongside live product pages across **Amazon**, **Target**, and **Walmart**.

---

## Part 1: Official Nintendo Switch OLED Compatibility & Hardware Rules

Before purchasing accessories, verify these official hardware specifications from Nintendo’s technical documentation:

1. **Screen Size & Factory Film (7.0 Inches vs. 6.2 Inches)**
   * **The Difference:** The Switch OLED features a 7.0-inch display, whereas the standard Nintendo Switch has a 6.2-inch display and the Switch Lite has a 5.5-inch display. Screen protectors made for the standard Switch **will not fit** the OLED model.
   * **Official Warning:** Nintendo pre-installs an "Anti-Scattering Adhesive Film" over the OLED glass at the factory to prevent glass splintering if dropped. **Do not attempt to peel this film off.** Third-party tempered glass screen protectors are designed to adhere directly on top of this film.
2. **Console Dimensions & Full-Width Kickstand**
   * The Switch OLED measures **4.0" H × 9.5" W × 0.55" D**, making it approximately **0.1 inches wider** than the original Switch (9.4").
   * The back features a full-width adjustable kickstand. Snap-on hard shell cases designed for the original narrow kickstand will block the OLED stand. Carrying travel cases must accommodate the extra 0.1-inch width.
3. **microSD Storage Specifications**
   * **Supported Types:** microSD (up to 2 GB), microSDHC (4 GB–32 GB), and microSDXC (64 GB–2 TB).
   * **Recommended Performance:** UHS-I (Ultra High Speed Phase I) compatible with read transfer speeds between **60 and 95 MB/s** (higher transfer speeds improve game load times).
   * **Crucial Rule:** Game save data is saved exclusively to the internal console storage (64 GB on OLED) and **cannot** be copied or saved to a microSD card. MicroSD storage is used for downloadable software, updates, DLC, and media captures.
4. **Power & Docking Profiles**
   * The official Nintendo Switch AC Adapter outputs **5.0V / 1.5A (7.5W)** and **15.0V / 2.6A (39W)** over USB Type-C.
   * The OLED Dock strictly requires a **15V / 2.6A USB-PD profile** to initiate TV-out mode. Standard 5V phone chargers can slowly charge the console in handheld mode while asleep, but will not power TV dock mode.
5. **Controller Compatibility**
   * Joy-Con controllers (L/R) and the Nintendo Switch Pro Controller are universally compatible across all Nintendo Switch models.

---

## Part 2: 15-Product Accessory Comparison Across 5 Essential Categories

### Category 1: Screen Protectors (Must be 7.0" OLED Specific)

1. **amFilm Tempered Glass Screen Protector for Nintendo Switch OLED 7.0" (3-Pack)**
   * **Price:** $7.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Laser-cut specifically for the 7.0" OLED panel; 0.3mm thickness allows the console to slide into the dock without friction; installs directly over the factory anti-scattering film.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Unbeatable value ($2.66 per protector), proven 9H surface hardness, oleophobic coating against smudges, and includes 3 protectors with application guide tabs.
2. **onn. Corning Glass Screen Protector for Nintendo Switch OLED with Application Tray**
   * **Price:** $14.93
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Tailored for the 7.0" OLED screen; dock-safe profile.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Uses genuine Corning aluminosilicate glass for superior impact resistance and includes a rigid plastic snap-on alignment tray for guaranteed bubble-free, straight installation.
3. **ivoler 4-Pack Tempered Glass Screen Protector with Alignment Frame for Switch OLED**
   * **Price:** $8.86
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** 7.0" OLED specific; 0.33mm dock-friendly thickness.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Offers 4 tempered glass protectors plus a physical auto-alignment frame tool for under $9, providing the most backup units if you share the console with kids.

---

### Category 2: Carrying Cases (Must Accommodate OLED 9.5" Width)

1. **Orzly Carrying Case for Nintendo Switch OLED Console**
   * **Price:** $23.91
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Specifically molded for the Switch OLED’s 9.5" length with Joy-Cons attached; also backwards compatible with standard Switch.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Tough EVA hard shell exterior, soft micro-fiber interior, padded screen cover flap, integrated slots for 8 physical game cartridges, and a large zippered mesh pouch that easily holds extra Joy-Cons, cables, or earphones.
2. **RDS Industries - Mario Kart Edition Game Traveler Deluxe Video Game Travel Case**
   * **Price:** $18.88
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed by Nintendo; fits both Switch OLED and standard Switch.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Officially licensed with hard-shell protection, molded recessed bottom to protect analog sticks and triggers, and includes two custom plastic game card cases (holding 4 games each) plus two microSD card cases.
3. **PowerA Protection Case for Nintendo Switch / OLED (Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Edition)**
   * **Price:** $24.99
   * **Retailer:** Target
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed by Nintendo; accommodates Switch OLED and original Switch.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** High-quality licensed artwork, durable molded outer shell with rubberized zipper pulls, built-in play-stand function inside the case, and storage for 9 game cards.

---

### Category 3: Extra Controller Options

1. **Nintendo Switch Pro Controller (Official)**
   * **Price:** $55.99 *(Sale, Reg. $79.99)*
   * **Retailer:** Target
   * **Compatibility:** 100% official Nintendo wireless controller for TV, tabletop, or handheld wireless play. Features HD Rumble, motion/gyro controls, amiibo NFC reader, and USB-C recharging.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** The gold standard for home console gaming. It delivers unmatched ergonomics, premium sticks and buttons, full feature parity (HD rumble + amiibo), and an industry-leading **40-hour rechargeable battery life**.
2. **Nintendo Switch Joy-Con (L/R) Wireless Controllers (Pastel Purple / Pastel Green)**
   * **Price:** $62.99 *(Sale, Reg. $89.99)*
   * **Retailer:** Target
   * **Compatibility:** 100% official Nintendo Joy-Con controllers; slide onto the OLED console rails or function as two independent wireless controllers with included wrist straps.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Essential for local party multiplayer. Combined with the Joy-Cons included in the Switch OLED box, this instantly expands your setup to **4 separate players** for games like *Mario Kart 8 Deluxe* or *Mario Party*.
3. **PowerA Enhanced Wireless Controller for Nintendo Switch - Black**
   * **Price:** $49.42
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed wireless controller; connects via Bluetooth; includes motion controls. (Note: does not include HD Rumble or amiibo NFC).
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Traditional gamepad layout at a lower entry price with **two mappable Advanced Gaming Buttons** on the rear grip, powered by standard AA batteries (or rechargeables) for up to 30 hours of play.

---

### Category 4: microSD Storage (Nintendo Spec: UHS-I, 60–95 MB/s+)

1. **SanDisk 128GB microSDXC Card - Super Mario Super Mushroom Edition (Officially Licensed)**
   * **Price:** $39.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed and certified by Nintendo; UHS-I U3 specification with up to 100 MB/s read and 90 MB/s write speeds.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Guarantees zero compatibility or firmware issues; collectible red Mario Mushroom design; ideal starting size for someone buying physical cartridges with moderate digital game updates.
2. **SanDisk Ultra 256GB microSDXC UHS-I Flash Memory Card with Adapter**
   * **Price:** $52.99
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** UHS-I Class 10 / U1; transfer speeds up to 150 MB/s (exceeds Nintendo’s 60–95 MB/s requirement).
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Delivers double the storage capacity (256 GB) for high-capacity digital game downloads, patches, and video captures from a trusted storage brand.
3. **Samsung EVO Select 256GB microSDXC Memory Card (UHS-I, U3, A2, V30)**
   * **Price:** $63.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Full Nintendo Switch compatibility; 130 MB/s read speed, UHS-I U3/A2 rated for rapid application loading.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Backed by Samsung's 6-proof protection (water, temperature, X-ray, magnetic, drop, wear) and fast A2 app loading performance.

---

### Category 5: Charging & Dock-Friendly Power Accessories

1. **Nintendo Switch AC Adapter (Official)**
   * **Price:** $24.47
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** 100% official Nintendo 39W power supply with dual 5.0V 1.5A and 15.0V 2.6A USB-C output profiles; required for the OLED TV dock and safe for direct console charging.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Eliminates the hassle of unhooking cables from behind your TV entertainment center every time you want to play in bed or pack for a trip. Guaranteed safe against dock handshaking failures.
2. **Nintendo Switch Joy-Con Charging Grip (Official)**
   * **Price:** $21.42
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Official Nintendo grip; docks and charges both Left and Right Joy-Cons via included USB-C cable while playing.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** **Crucial beginner detail:** The Joy-Con grip included in the Switch OLED box is purely passive plastic and *cannot* charge Joy-Cons. This charging grip allows you to play on the TV indefinitely without having to snap Joy-Cons back onto the console to charge.
3. **MARSDOCK 45W AC Adapter Fast Charger (15V/2.6A TV Mode Support)**
   * **Price:** $12.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Supports standard 15V 2.6A TV dock mode as well as handheld charging with an attached 5 ft USB-C cable.

Can I use an SD card on Nintendo Switch?

No. Only microSD cards can be used on the Nintendo Switch console. Due to the slot size, SD cards and miniSD cards are not compatible with Nintendo Switch.

Can I use a microSD card on Nintendo Switch 2?

No. Only microSD Express cards can be used on the Nintendo Switch 2 console.

For more information on compatibility, please see microSD Card and microSD Express Card Compatibility.

Are microSD cards included with the Nintendo Switch system?

No, microSD cards are sold separately.

Which microSD cards are supported?

The following types of microSD cards are supported on Nintendo Switch:

microSD (up to 2 GB)
microSDHC (4 GB - 32 GB)
microSDXC (64 GB - 2 TB)

Important:In order to use a microSDXC card on the Nintendo Switch console, a system update is required.

In order to improve your gameplay experience, using a microSD card with a higher transfer speed is recommended.

High-speed microSD card recommendations:

UHS-I (Ultra High Speed Phase I) compatible
Transfer speed 60 - 95 MB/sec (the higher the transfer speed, the better gameplay experience on Nintendo Switch)
What information can be saved to a microSD card on Nintendo Switch?
Downloadable software
Software update data
Downloadable content (DLC)
Screenshots and captured videos

Important: Game save data is stored to the System Memory and cannot be copied or saved to a microSD card.

Can I move data from the system memory to a microSD card?

Screenshots and captured gameplay videos can be moved from the system memory to a microSD card, and vice versa. You can also transfer downloadable software if the system is updated to Version 10.0.0 or higher.

When a microSD card is inserted in the console, it becomes the default save location for downloadable software.

Game save data cannot be copied to a microSD card.

Can I use multiple microSD cards with my system?

We recommend using a single microSD card with your Nintendo Switch console. If you run out of space, you can copy over all the data to a larger microSD card.

Keep in mind that downloadable software saved to multiple microSD cards cannot be combined later into a single microSD card.

# Nintendo Switch OLED Starter Buying Guide & Retailer Comparison

This buying guide is based on live checks of official Nintendo technical specifications and support documentation, alongside live product pages across **Amazon**, **Target**, and **Walmart**.

---

## Part 1: Official Nintendo Switch OLED Compatibility & Hardware Rules

Before purchasing accessories, verify these official hardware specifications from Nintendo’s technical documentation:

1. **Screen Size & Factory Film (7.0 Inches vs. 6.2 Inches)**
   * **The Difference:** The Switch OLED features a 7.0-inch display, whereas the standard Nintendo Switch has a 6.2-inch display and the Switch Lite has a 5.5-inch display. Screen protectors made for the standard Switch **will not fit** the OLED model.
   * **Official Warning:** Nintendo pre-installs an "Anti-Scattering Adhesive Film" over the OLED glass at the factory to prevent glass splintering if dropped. **Do not attempt to peel this film off.** Third-party tempered glass screen protectors are designed to adhere directly on top of this film.
2. **Console Dimensions & Full-Width Kickstand**
   * The Switch OLED measures **4.0" H × 9.5" W × 0.55" D**, making it approximately **0.1 inches wider** than the original Switch (9.4").
   * The back features a full-width adjustable kickstand. Snap-on hard shell cases designed for the original narrow kickstand will block the OLED stand. Carrying travel cases must accommodate the extra 0.1-inch width.
3. **microSD Storage Specifications**
   * **Supported Types:** microSD (up to 2 GB), microSDHC (4 GB–32 GB), and microSDXC (64 GB–2 TB).
   * **Recommended Performance:** UHS-I (Ultra High Speed Phase I) compatible with read transfer speeds between **60 and 95 MB/s** (higher transfer speeds improve game load times).
   * **Crucial Rule:** Game save data is saved exclusively to the internal console storage (64 GB on OLED) and **cannot** be copied or saved to a microSD card. MicroSD storage is used for downloadable software, updates, DLC, and media captures.
4. **Power & Docking Profiles**
   * The official Nintendo Switch AC Adapter outputs **5.0V / 1.5A (7.5W)** and **15.0V / 2.6A (39W)** over USB Type-C.
   * The OLED Dock strictly requires a **15V / 2.6A USB-PD profile** to initiate TV-out mode. Standard 5V phone chargers can slowly charge the console in handheld mode while asleep, but will not power TV dock mode.
5. **Controller Compatibility**
   * Joy-Con controllers (L/R) and the Nintendo Switch Pro Controller are universally compatible across all Nintendo Switch models.

---

## Part 2: 15-Product Accessory Comparison Across 5 Essential Categories

### Category 1: Screen Protectors (Must be 7.0" OLED Specific)

1. **amFilm Tempered Glass Screen Protector for Nintendo Switch OLED 7.0" (3-Pack)**
   * **Price:** $7.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Laser-cut specifically for the 7.0" OLED panel; 0.3mm thickness allows the console to slide into the dock without friction; installs directly over the factory anti-scattering film.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Unbeatable value ($2.66 per protector), proven 9H surface hardness, oleophobic coating against smudges, and includes 3 protectors with application guide tabs.
2. **onn. Corning Glass Screen Protector for Nintendo Switch OLED with Application Tray**
   * **Price:** $14.93
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Tailored for the 7.0" OLED screen; dock-safe profile.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Uses genuine Corning aluminosilicate glass for superior impact resistance and includes a rigid plastic snap-on alignment tray for guaranteed bubble-free, straight installation.
3. **ivoler 4-Pack Tempered Glass Screen Protector with Alignment Frame for Switch OLED**
   * **Price:** $8.86
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** 7.0" OLED specific; 0.33mm dock-friendly thickness.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Offers 4 tempered glass protectors plus a physical auto-alignment frame tool for under $9, providing the most backup units if you share the console with kids.

---

### Category 2: Carrying Cases (Must Accommodate OLED 9.5" Width)

1. **Orzly Carrying Case for Nintendo Switch OLED Console**
   * **Price:** $23.91
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Specifically molded for the Switch OLED’s 9.5" length with Joy-Cons attached; also backwards compatible with standard Switch.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Tough EVA hard shell exterior, soft micro-fiber interior, padded screen cover flap, integrated slots for 8 physical game cartridges, and a large zippered mesh pouch that easily holds extra Joy-Cons, cables, or earphones.
2. **RDS Industries - Mario Kart Edition Game Traveler Deluxe Video Game Travel Case**
   * **Price:** $18.88
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed by Nintendo; fits both Switch OLED and standard Switch.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Officially licensed with hard-shell protection, molded recessed bottom to protect analog sticks and triggers, and includes two custom plastic game card cases (holding 4 games each) plus two microSD card cases.
3. **PowerA Protection Case for Nintendo Switch / OLED (Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Edition)**
   * **Price:** $24.99
   * **Retailer:** Target
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed by Nintendo; accommodates Switch OLED and original Switch.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** High-quality licensed artwork, durable molded outer shell with rubberized zipper pulls, built-in play-stand function inside the case, and storage for 9 game cards.

---

### Category 3: Extra Controller Options

1. **Nintendo Switch Pro Controller (Official)**
   * **Price:** $55.99 *(Sale, Reg. $79.99)*
   * **Retailer:** Target
   * **Compatibility:** 100% official Nintendo wireless controller for TV, tabletop, or handheld wireless play. Features HD Rumble, motion/gyro controls, amiibo NFC reader, and USB-C recharging.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** The gold standard for home console gaming. It delivers unmatched ergonomics, premium sticks and buttons, full feature parity (HD rumble + amiibo), and an industry-leading **40-hour rechargeable battery life**.

   * **Price:** $62.99 *(Sale, Reg. $89.99)*
   * **Retailer:** Target
   * **Compatibility:** 100% official Nintendo Joy-Con controllers; slide onto the OLED console rails or function as two independent wireless controllers with included wrist straps.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Essential for local party multiplayer. Combined with the Joy-Cons included in the Switch OLED box, this instantly expands your setup to **4 separate players** for games like *Mario Kart 8 Deluxe* or *Mario Party*.
3. **PowerA Enhanced Wireless Controller for Nintendo Switch - Black**
   * **Price:** $49.42
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed wireless controller; connects via Bluetooth; includes motion controls. (Note: does not include HD Rumble or amiibo NFC).
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Traditional gamepad layout at a lower entry price with **two mappable Advanced Gaming Buttons** on the rear grip, powered by standard AA batteries (or rechargeables) for up to 30 hours of play.

---

### Category 4: microSD Storage (Nintendo Spec: UHS-I, 60–95 MB/s+)

1. **SanDisk 128GB microSDXC Card - Super Mario Super Mushroom Edition (Officially Licensed)**
   * **Price:** $39.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Officially licensed and certified by Nintendo; UHS-I U3 specification with up to 100 MB/s read and 90 MB/s write speeds.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Guarantees zero compatibility or firmware issues; collectible red Mario Mushroom design; ideal starting size for someone buying physical cartridges with moderate digital game updates.
2. **SanDisk Ultra 256GB microSDXC UHS-I Flash Memory Card with Adapter**
   * **Price:** $52.99
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** UHS-I Class 10 / U1; transfer speeds up to 150 MB/s (exceeds Nintendo’s 60–95 MB/s requirement).
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Delivers double the storage capacity (256 GB) for high-capacity digital game downloads, patches, and video captures from a trusted storage brand.
3. **Samsung EVO Select 256GB microSDXC Memory Card (UHS-I, U3, A2, V30)**
   * **Price:** $63.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Full Nintendo Switch compatibility; 130 MB/s read speed, UHS-I U3/A2 rated for rapid application loading.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Backed by Samsung's 6-proof protection (water, temperature, X-ray, magnetic, drop, wear) and fast A2 app loading performance.

---

### Category 5: Charging & Dock-Friendly Power Accessories

1. **Nintendo Switch AC Adapter (Official)**
   * **Price:** $24.47
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** 100% official Nintendo 39W power supply with dual 5.0V 1.5A and 15.0V 2.6A USB-C output profiles; required for the OLED TV dock and safe for direct console charging.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Eliminates the hassle of unhooking cables from behind your TV entertainment center every time you want to play in bed or pack for a trip. Guaranteed safe against dock handshaking failures.
2. **Nintendo Switch Joy-Con Charging Grip (Official)**
   * **Price:** $21.42
   * **Retailer:** Walmart
   * **Compatibility:** Official Nintendo grip; docks and charges both Left and Right Joy-Cons via included USB-C cable while playing.
   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** **Crucial beginner detail:** The Joy-Con grip included in the Switch OLED box is purely passive plastic and *cannot* charge Joy-Cons. This charging grip allows you to play on the TV indefinitely without having to snap Joy-Cons back onto the console to charge.
3. **MARSDOCK 45W AC Adapter Fast Charger (15V/2.6A TV Mode Support)**
   * **Price:** $12.99
   * **Retailer:** Amazon
   * **Compatibility:** Supports standard 15V 2.6A TV dock mode as well as handheld charging with an attached 5 ft USB-C cable.
